title: A halted configuration is fixed
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine and let $c$ be a configuration for an input string. If the state component of $c$ is empty, then one step of $M$ leaves $c$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A machine with symbol alphabet and state set
An input string and configuration $c$ for that input
The state component of $c$ is empty
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and $c$ a configuration whose state
component is empty (the machine has halted).  Then one computation step of $M$
leaves $c$ unchanged.
